FAQs1.question: Why does chimney sweeping matter if my fireplace still works?
FAQs1.answer: A fireplace can seem to work normally even when soot and deposits are building up inside the flue. Sweeping helps clear those deposits, improve ventilation, and reduce the chance of blockages or safety issues developing over time.

FAQs2.question: How does chimney sweeping help my fire burn better?
FAQs2.answer: A cleaner flue allows smoke and gases to pass through more freely, which supports better airflow. That improved ventilation can help your fuel burn more effectively and make your fireplace easier to use.

FAQs3.question: Is chimney sweeping useful before autumn and winter?
FAQs3.answer: Yes, it's often a sensible time to arrange it. If your fireplace hasn't been used for a while, sweeping helps remove soot and any build up so it's in better condition for regular seasonal use.
